chunks: Travel is a portion of torment.

key_terms.اَلسَّفَرُ: travel; journeying from one place to another
key_terms.اَلْعَذَابِ: torment; hardship and suffering in context
key_terms.قِطْعَةٌ: a portion or part of something

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about the hardship of travel?
ai.summary: This hadith describes travel as involving hardship and discomfort. It reflects the burdens commonly associated with being away from ease, rest, and familiarity.
